main_claim: Merab Dvalishvili, Topuria's close friend and fellow fighter, says on Ariel Helwani's podcast that Topuria is enjoying life, is doing well and will take the belt back when he returns.
note: The article is built on Dvalishvili ('uno de sus mejores amigos', 'excampeón del peso gallo', so a friend-fighter, not team) saying 'se lo está pasando en grande', 'le va muy bien, y se encuentra bien (físicamente)' and 'cuando vuelva, nadie podrá pararle', which reads as a friend's appraisal of his mood, condition and level rather than a statement of fact by him, his team, the promotion or a named report; the June loss, the orbital and nose fractures, the six-month suspension and the 'puras especulaciones' about a year-end return are the writer's recap. A careful editor could instead take 'se encuentra bien (físicamente)' as a named person stating his condition, giving act gives_news_of_him, fact health, firmness reported and health yes; Topuria himself is not quoted ('reconocer el revés' is only described).
